title: Forgiveness is a stronger fast than self-display.
summary: Guru replaces external austerity with interior virtue and says the stronger practice is forgiveness joined to conduct and contentment.
takeaway: The harder fast may be the one nobody applauds.
lifeApplication: Practice one hidden renunciation today: release retaliation, self-justification, or the need to be seen doing good.

source.shortMeaning: Forgiveness is not weakness here; it is the doorway into fearlessness.
source.lifeApplication: Choose the discipline that purifies the heart, not merely the schedule.

evidence.coreClaim: Forgiveness is not weakness here; it is the doorway into fearlessness.
evidence.turn: Forgive deeply enough that fear loses its throne.
evidence.practicalImplication: Practice one hidden renunciation today: release retaliation, self-justification, or the need to be seen doing good.
